blurb: To become a member of the Club, you must be sponsored for membership by a stockholder-member of the Club, and the application must be seconded by two other stockholder-members. In addition, you must be acquainted with at least five governors of the Club. Information about Club fees and amenities should be obtained from the sponsoring member.
